title: Daedalus realm release preparation
summary: One shattered planet, distinct realm games, original stories and a shared land identity. This catalog records sources and next work; it offers no mint or sale.
identityPolicy: Record IDs are browser directory labels, not production world allocation, deed ownership or a newly registered realm. Use the authenticated current provider directory and land registry.

statusMeaning.LIVE: Documented playable Unreal system; not freshly verified by this crew.
statusMeaning.SERVER: Existing generator/provider source; native/public-play status is pending or unverified.
statusMeaning.NAMED: Named design; complete generator/renderer not established.
statusMeaning.DISTRICT: Existing realm district whose runtime integration is pending.
statusMeaning.PROPOSED: Provisional design/source, without live canonical allocation.

evidencePolicy.newBrowserPages: Shattered Planet Sky Expedition, Gallery City, Parcels, Portal Expedition and the metaverse hub are new source previews; running gameplay has not been checked.
evidencePolicy.historicalEvidence: Older ADR proof and current team messages are attributed records, not a new successful run.

canonicalLandDesign.sourceStatus: PROPOSED; records the owner's ten-thousand-per-realm goal.
canonicalLandDesign.layout: Spiral numbering, separate land-to-cell mapping, estates and tugging, while preserving the starter lane.
canonicalLandDesign.releaseStatus: No generated-supply, sale-availability or on-chain allocation claim.
canonicalLandDesign.bundleStatus: Portal egg, avatars/creatures, rarity and independent shiny are recorded design. Actual mint randomness, odds, lifecycle, values and reward formulas remain owner work.

sharedLandBlockers: Canonical realm/number land registry and its deployment must be reconciled with legacy island lane slots.
Legacy RealmIslands Deed has no realm/world field and one global configured contract; wider realm identity binding is pending.
Current chain ownership transfer reconciliation and durable metadata publication are not verified.
No contract deployment, holder allocation, mint eligibility, sale price or launch date was observed in this audit.

engineering.protocol: Claim exact owned paths; preserve prior edits; hand off head, files, routes, schema and source limits; native/editor acceptance is separate.
engineering.deployment: The present legacy chain pipeline supports guarded Sepolia deployment and refuses mainnet. This source sprint performs no deployment.
